connector.name: Checkmails - Email Verification
connector.registryDescription: Verify email deliverability by SMTP. Catch-all/disposable/role detection. EU-hosted, GDPR-ready.
connector.summary: Hosted at checkmails.eu over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace eu.checkmails, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer chk_<your API key> - paid checkmails plan, get it at https://checkmails.eu/app
